sentences.pattern: the card was refused and the decision was delivered {N:[0-9]+} days ago
the refusal was for a fee not paid
the refusal was for another reason
the card is ready and {N:[0-9]+} days have passed since the office said so
the card is held and the holder wants to work
the card is held and the holder wants to run a business
the card is held and the holder moved {N:[0-9]+} working days ago
the card is held and the holder is away from Poland for {N:[0-9]+} months at a stretch
the card is held and was lost again by the holder's fault
the card is held and was lost for the first time
the application is made and the applicant leaves Poland for {N:[0-9]+} days

rules: % Refusal (questions 45-47): the fee is never returned; an appeal within 14 days of delivery; a new application after a refusal for a missing fee.
% Collection (questions 3, 9, 49): 60 days from the office's notice, then the card is annulled.
% Change of address (question 51): inform the voivode within 15 working days.
% Leaving after the application (questions 4, 43): status UKR is lost above 30 days, and no card follows.
% Absence of a holder (questions 3, 4, 9, 53, 54): under 6 months kept, over 6 months may be withdrawn; at exactly 6 the texts differ ('at least 6' against 'above 6').
% Replacement of a lost card (question 60): 200, and 300 when lost again by the holder's fault.
